visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a white quilted puffer jacket and a pink backpack, walks along a narrow urban sidewalk. She turns toward the camera with a wide smile and expressive hand movements. The background features a tall building and a 'Sushi Express' sign. (2) Transitions to an indoor restaurant setting with bright, warm lighting. The woman sits at a table, using chopsticks to pick up various sushi pieces. She displays intense facial expressions of enjoyment. Close-up shots highlight the textures of raw fish, melted cheese, and garnishes. (3) A man with black hair appears briefly, holding a plate of eel rice and looking at the camera while eating. The environment is a clean, modern sushi shop with a conveyor belt visible in the background. (4) The woman points at two tall stacks of colorful plates on the table, indicating a large meal. She gestures excitedly with both hands. A smartphone interface is shown through a screen recording, demonstrating how to use a specific mobile application. (5) Returns to the woman in the restaurant; she gives a thumbs-up and double peace signs to the camera. The table is filled with empty plates and small dishes. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the indoor sequence.
